correctness.rationale: Full proof reconstructs the polytope support function by sorted greedy rank increments. For arbitrary signed u, down-closure yields a positive/negative support split. The layer-cake integral and Euclidean Minkowski inequality bound each support by its inverse-scaled norm times the sharp subset ratio. Equality in the sign split excludes mixed signs; equality in the vector triangle integral excludes multiple nonzero level sets, forcing exactly a signed weighted indicator. Substitution verifies every candidate; matroid flat/connected support statements follow by strict quotient improvements; uniform matroid rank-square threshold by two monotone cardinality branches. The finite Python checker confirmed 126 positive-capacity submodular profiles and 15,120 additional sample normals. It is corroboration, not universal proof.

Its exhaustive equality directions recover connected matroid flats and exhibit a sharp rank-square mechanism in standard uniform matroids; neither is an arbitrary finite recomputation or a normalization check.
